title: Cloudflare chat completions speak OpenAI
summary:
A text API debugging day: Cloudflare compatibility, consistent SSE output, and less surprising stream errors and replays.

The text API now uses Cloudflare's OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint and omits null or undefined request fields, including nested optional parameters.

Text API streams preserve existing SSE events and wrap other chunks as data events. Plain-text chunks become chat completion deltas, so clients receive SSE-formatted output even when an upstream stream does not provide it.

Streaming API errors now return HTTP error responses rather than successful streams. Completed streams are sanitized before caching and marked for replay on repeat requests.
